alex: Morning — planning engine merge window tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Kernel ABI micro-bump + quant matmul v2 landing. I want a short handoff checklist and rollback criteria. cc @marta @sam @ops
marta: Ack. I'm on canary metrics and post-deploy smoke. Need exact build tag and pin list.
sam: Can we do staged canary: 1%, 10% after 10m, 50% after 30m? Also set deploybot sticky-pin TTL 2h for quick rollback.
ops: Night window ok for us. Ensure region fallback is enabled. I'll prep runbook.
alex: Build tag: `engine-quant-2026-03-21-rc3`. Kernel tag: `kernel-abi-1.2.1-micro`. Pin list:
```
models:
  - llama2-13b-q8
  - redwood-matmul-v2
runtimes:
  - engine-quant-2026-03-21-rc3
```
jia: Noting that q8 build changes memory layout. Need KV cache smoke for long-context 8k tests.
deploy-bot: preflight checks started for engine-quant-2026-03-21-rc3
deploy-bot: preflight: artifact integrity ✅, kernels compiled ✅, canary infra smoke ❌ (kv-cache leak repro on 1 node)
sam: Ah — kv-cache leak repro. Is that deterministic or load related?
marta: Repro steps attached: small script that does long prefix + rapid requests. Brief log:
```
ERROR runtime: kv cache overflow at 0x7ff...\nstack: ...
```
ryan: I'll take the repro, instrument a guard and re-run. ETA 2.5h.
alex: Given leak, proposal:
- Hold merge until fix merged and preflight green
- If we must proceed, lower canary to 0.5% and enable immediate fallback to previous kernel/engine pair
- Post a short release note: "Delayed: quant build due to KV cache leak" :warning:
marta: Agree. Also add health check: `kv_cache_utilization < 0.85` alert during canary.
ops: I'll add circuit breaker policy to routing to divert 100% if error rate > 1% sustained 5m.
jia: After fix, re-run these tests: long-context smoke, multi-tenant mem pressure, perf regression 95th pct.
alex: OK — Ryan will post results. If green, we'll aim for merge at 05:00 UTC fallback window. If not, we'll postpone 24h.
ryan: Taking it. Will update thread with test artifacts and deploybot preflight output.
deploy-bot: noted. preflight blocked: waiting on new artifact.
alex: Thanks all. I'll write a small release note draft and ping legal/comms if we need customer-facing note.
marta: Draft released here: https://go/release-notes/drafts/engine-quant-rc3 — feel free to edit. :memo:
sam: Cool. If fix is small, let's keep rollback criteria simple: any increase >0.5% in generation error rate or mem leak reproducing => immediate rollback.
ops: Confirmed. I'll be on call during the window. :phone:
ryan: Starting root-cause now. Will post at 2355552800 update.
alex: Closing — stand by for updates. :thumbsup:
